zh-Hans: 1.7.45（286）：新增系统分享入口、任务小组件和‘文件’中的 Floe 位置；补齐定时计划的快捷指令导入与结束清理提醒。扩展常用 Apple 能力，并改进 Office、媒体处理、Linux 软重启、浏览器会话和子 Agent 恢复。新增打印／PDF 实际预览与 Excel 导出选项。请重点测试预览分页、保存返回与笔迹封面、分享文件后的草稿保留、文件保存重开、快捷指令导入及计划结束提醒。系统时间自动化需在快捷指令中设置；健康、NFC 等能力需在支持的设备上授权验证。
en-US: 1.7.45 (286): Added system sharing, task widgets and a Floe location in Files. Added schedule Shortcut import and cleanup reminders. Expanded Apple integrations and improved Office, media processing, Linux restarts, browser sessions and subagent recovery. Added actual print/PDF previews and more Excel export options. Please test preview pagination, saving and returning with updated ink covers, shared-file draft preservation, saving and reopening documents, Shortcut import and plan cleanup reminders. Configure time automations in Shortcuts. Health, NFC and other hardware features require a supported device and permissions.
